title: Beth Plale
summary: Beth A. Plale is Executive Director of the School of Computer and Data Sciences at the University of Oregon. She is recognized for contributions to open science, trust in AI, fairness, reproducibility, and data science policy. Her career spans academia, leadership roles at Indiana University and the Pervasive Technology Institute, and a science advisory position at the National Science Foundation.

mechanisms.title: Data provenance and open science leadership
mechanisms.explanation: Plale has been a founding scientist of the Research Data Alliance and author of key works on data provenance, aiming to improve open access to data and support reproducibility in e-science.
